title: Detailed Qwen activity
items: Qwen Local and Ultra can now show longer, task-specific public activity summaries (up to 120 words), separate from observed processor events.
The activity timeline expands by default, keeps the latest Qwen summary visible, and shows each saved event's elapsed processing time.
Real context-token counts, compute route, Deep stage, and observed native reasoning stream length appear without exposing private reasoning text.
Deep still drafts, reviews, and produces the final answer; drafts and critiques remain private and are not displayed as conversation answers.
After GitHub Pages rebuilds, update the FUPCJ processor with Update-Venture.ps1 for detailed live backend events. Older runs remain readable.
